parsed.why: Courts repeatedly enjoin hostile statutes: facilities bill restrained, care ban struck down, marker blocks upheld. But 2026 biological-definitions law is enacted and pending, plus flag/drag restrictions and no state hate-crime GI coverage. Above parent, below genuinely protective divisions.

Tier-1 universal exposure: birth-sex facility confinement in public buildings including airports, criminal penalties plus private bounty suits, licence invalidation, and a 'Do Not Travel' flag. Remedy unresolved. Worst division here, far below parent.

'Most Protective' tier: GI nondiscrimination since 2001 including public accommodations, hate-crime enhancements, panic-defense repeal, X marker, shield laws, no facility ban. Only parent passport/entry regime remains. Strongest dossier.

Low-risk tier: codified nondiscrimination, explicit hate-crime coverage, conversion-therapy and panic-defense bans, reformed marker rules, no local facility ban. Shortfalls on healthcare equity and incarcerated protections; parent passport/entry regime still applies.

Most-protective tier with shield laws, insurance coverage and refuge protections, but birth-sex prison placement used as discipline and two anti-trans ballot initiatives pending add a hostile layer beneath the parent regime.
